text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in 504/timeouts from hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate — 17:02 UTC, increased error rate to 18% for tenant=acme-prod :rotating_light:
Priya: seeing it in dashboards, customer reports timeouts and retries. Latency tailed up before 504s.
Devon: digging into autoscale metrics — KEDA scaledobjects show no new replicas created during the spike. HPA didn't trigger either.
SRE-Liz: can you paste the ScaledObject for that deployment? suspect annotation mismatch with cooldowns we rolled out last week.
Devon: pasted below (redacted):
```
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: inference-scaledobj-acme
  annotations:
    scaler.keda.sh/cooldown: "true"
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: inference-deployment-acme
  pollingInterval: 30
  cooldownPeriod: 120
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata: {...}
```
SRE-Liz: aha — the annotation we intended to use was `keda.sh/disable-cooldown: "true"` in our env, not `scaler.keda.sh/cooldown`. The operator ignores the unknown annotation, so KEDA used default cooldown behavior and polling interval was too long to react to the sudden queue spike.
Alex: logs from keda-operator show repeated "no scale needed" decisions while queue backlog increased. snippet: `Decided not to scale: within cooldown window` but our annotation name was wrong.
Support-Jamal: customer-facing status: "We're seeing repeated timeouts in prod during bursts, impact to API calls. Any ETA?"
Priya: immediate mitigation: increase minReplicaCount on the deployment to 3 (from 1) and lower HPA target to absorb current load. Also reduce pollingInterval to 5s on scaledobject for that tenant.
Infra-Maria: making the changes now (kubectl apply). will also restart keda-operator to pick up annotation semantics in case of cached state.
Devon: repro steps captured: 1) run 200 RPS constant for 30s against /v1/generate with seq_len=512; 2) observe queue_depth > 800 and requests queued > 200; 3) KEDA pollingInterval=30s -> scale decision delayed -> gateway 504s at ~20s after spike.
SRE-Liz: root cause summary in one line: mis-typed annotation + conservative polling/cooldown settings prevented KEDA from reacting fast enough to a burst, causing scale-up lag and upstream gateway 504s.
Alex: post-fix checks: Cloudwatch/Datadog shows replicas scaled to 4 within 10s after changes, 504 rate dropped to <1%. Running a 5-min canary load now.
Support-Jamal: replied to customer with interim RCA and mitigation steps; promised follow-up.
Priya: action items: 1) add CI lint that validates ScaledObject annotations against our approved list, 2) update runbook to include minReplicaCount recommendations for bursty tenants, 3) change default pollingInterval to 5s for low-latency tenants, 4) alerting tweak to notify on queue_depth rising >200 for >10s.
SRE-Liz: tagging follow-up ops ticket and owners. thanks everyone. :tada:
